name: r3d_set_camera
notes: copies cam matrix to 7AF8, scales (x/y halved, z by 7D2E, y*0.75), sets far limit 7D2E=7FFF00h/max(|2zoom|,100h)

name: r3d_draw_object
notes: draws one 3DX object: LOD, cull, parts, planes, vertices, edges, faces. DS:8560=bank seg. Callers 13E3,DF08,E7AC

name: r3d_probe_object
notes: 00D3 without drawing: sets C686 bit7 when the point is inside a closed model (collision/inside test, caller 0FFB)

name: r3d_hook_div0
notes: saves real-mode INT0 vector to DS:5EB6/8 and installs 11EB:0975

name: r3d_unhook_div0
notes: restores INT0 vector from DS:5EB6/8

name: r3d_frustum_test
notes: sphere/pyramid cull: far limit 7D2E, 2*zhi+radius >= |xhi|,|yhi|; ZF=1 visible, AX=FFFF culled

name: r3d_setup_parts
notes: per-part matrices (7B1C+24h*k), eye vectors 7C3C, light vectors 7C6C, part origins 7CAE; uses 1433:0286/03A9/02E2/0219

name: r3d_part_pivot
notes: origin_part = origin_obj + pivot*M_root - pivot*M_part (rotation about pivot); eye slot = -pivot

name: r3d_light_root
notes: copies light vector 7D54 to 7C6C, rotates by ObjMat^T, 7D4C=7C6C+6

name: r3d_light_part
notes: light vector for a part: 7C6C rotated by part matrix (DI), stored at [7D4C], 7D4C+=6

name: r3d_plane_vartest
notes: 8100 var val element: if vars[var]!=val then 7D38=7Fh (next plane hidden)

name: r3d_plane_partsw
notes: 80pp element: switch eye ptr BX=7C3C+6pp and light ptr 7D4C=7C6C+6pp

name: r3d_planes
notes: plane visibility n.eye+d>=0 -> 76D2[], shade 77D2[], vertex-needed flags 79D2[], BSP order 78D2 (0E5F)

name: r3d_clear_vertex_flags
notes: zeroes (|nverts|+2)/2 words at DS:79D2

name: r3d_plane_shade
notes: shade byte ((n.L)<<2)>>16 into 77D2[di]; only copied to 7D5A, never used (dead)

name: r3d_xform_vertices
notes: transform needed vertices into C688 (s32 x3, 16B) and project into D688 (8B); handles part prefixes 8000-800F

name: r3d_xform_partsw
notes: part switch prefix in plane path: BX=7D20+36pp, origin 7CAE+12pp -> 7CA2

name: r3d_xform_partsw2
notes: part switch prefix met inside 0819 (no-plane path)

name: r3d_xform_one
notes: v*M + origin (s32), then 0906 project; advances bp+=8 di+=16 si+=6

name: r3d_project_ortho_left
notes: map-mode projection for 7D5E<16: x_hi << (16-cl)

name: r3d_project_ortho
notes: map-mode projection dispatch on DS:7D5E

name: r3d_project
notes: perspective x/z,y/z in 3 z ranges (>=100h,>=1,<1 => x_hi=8000h behind); map mode if 7D5E!=0; idiv overflow caught by INT0 handler

name: r3d_div0_handler
notes: divide overflow recovery: skips idiv+cdq (IP+3), redoes (dx:ax>>8)/cx and returns quotient<<8

name: r3d_near_bisect
notes: bisects segment p0p1 until mid z hi is 0 or 1; result x@7D42 y@7D46; used for edges crossing the near plane

name: r3d_build_edges
notes: for each edge (v0,v1) with both vertices needed -> 0B3F; edge records at DS:5EBA+24*i

name: r3d_edge_v1_behind
notes: edge with v1 behind camera: v0 projected, near point by 0990 -> rec+8/+10h, flags|=4040h

name: r3d_make_edge
notes: builds 24-byte edge record from D688 projections + centre 85D2/85D4, near-plane handling, calls 12EF:0333 clip

name: r3d_edge_reject
notes: both ends behind camera: rec+2 = 8080h

name: r3d_edge_v0_behind
notes: edge with v0 behind camera (mirror of 0A81)

name: r3d_draw_faces
notes: planes in file order (nplanes>0), BSP order list 78D2 (<0), or single face list (=0); calls 0CAC/0CED

name: r3d_draw_face_plane
notes: if 76D2[plane]>7Fh: 7D5A=shade, si=face-list offset table[plane], 0CED

name: r3d_face_cond
notes: conditional element 80|v val: skip next element if vars[v]!=val

name: r3d_face_list
notes: face-list interpreter: polygon (n<20h edges+colour) -> 12EF:003E/010A; 40h lines -> 1359:0040/0049; 20h points (dead); 80h cond; FFh end

name: r3d_face_lines
notes: line element 40|n: colour 7D50[c], n edges drawn with 1359:0049, 7D4E=last edge record

name: r3d_face_points
notes: point element 20|n: computes screen positions, never draws

name: r3d_bsp_order
notes: iterative BSP walk: visible node -> back,self,front; hidden -> front,back; output FF-terminated list

name: r3d_object_extent
notes: max |x|,|y|,|z| of the vertices of LOD0 model; no direct callers

name: r3d_shared_verts
notes: builds shared-vertex table DS:4EB6 (*7AF8) from count after the 3DX offset table (0 in shipped data); caller DAE8

name: r3d_clip_line_queue
notes: builds edge record 5EBA from 4 s16, clips (0333), adds to polygon (003E); no callers

name: r3d_poly_add_edge
notes: accumulates flags 85B2; near pts (00E0); rasterises via 1359:0719; tracks left/right wall y ranges

name: r3d_note_left
notes: left wall y range min/max into 85B4/85B6

name: r3d_note_right
notes: right wall y range min/max into 85B8/85BA

name: r3d_note_zclip_point
notes: saves rec+10h..16h (near-plane point) to 8588/8590, 85BE++

name: r3d_poly_finish
notes: 1359:0040 colour; close near-plane gap, wall fills 0185/019B, 1359:0052 fill, reset 85B2..85BE and wall ranges

name: r3d_draw_line
notes: colour via 1359:0040, edge record, clip, emit via 01F9; no callers

name: r3d_line_emit
notes: if rec flag bit7 clear call 1359:0049

name: r3d_clip_flags16
notes: edge side flags (bit0 right,1 left for end0; 2,3 end1) into rec+2 and clamped y0/y1 into rec+6/+0E

name: r3d_clip_noop
notes: no clipping needed: BP=BX DX=CX CF=0

name: r3d_clip_intercept
notes: intersection of the edge with the window border selected by AL using dx/dy 85AC/85AE; CF=1 if off window

name: r3d_outcode16
notes: Cohen-Sutherland outcode: 1 y<ymin 2 y>ymax 4 x<xmin 8 x>xmax; sets 85C0 on compare overflow

name: r3d_clip_inside_bug
notes: rec+2=0 then NEAR ret from a far routine (latent original bug, unreachable)

name: r3d_clip_sx32
notes: sign-extends the four coordinates and takes the 32-bit path

name: r3d_clip_edge
notes: clips edge to window 85CA..85D0: s16 fast path (0465), s32 bisection path (0359); writes rec+2 flags, clipped coords

name: r3d_bisect_in
notes: 32-step bisection moving the outside end of an s32 edge towards the window

name: r3d_bisect_out
notes: 32-step bisection variant that keeps the inside point (s32 edge)

name: r3d_clip_flags32
notes: side flags and clamped y for the 32-bit path

name: r3d_on_border
notes: BP!=0 if point lies exactly on a window border

name: r3d_outcode32
notes: outcode of an s32 point against the window

name: r3d_set_page
notes: 85C6=page; 85EA=[85E2+2*page]; no callers (DB71 does it inline)

name: r3d_setcolor_E
notes: EGA mode colour setter (GC regs 3CEh); dead

name: r3d_setcolor_M
notes: mode M colour: 85D6=ax; ramp shade al=max(al-[4894],al&F0) when ah=FF and al>=A0; es=85EA

name: r3d_setcolor_C
notes: CGA mode colour pattern 914A/914C; dead

name: r3d_setcolor_T
notes: Tandy mode colour pattern 914E; dead

name: r3d_pixel_E
notes: EGA window-clipped pixel; dead

name: r3d_pixel_M
notes: mode M window-clipped pixel; no callers

name: r3d_pixel_C
notes: CGA pixel; dead

name: r3d_pixel_T
notes: Tandy pixel; dead

name: r3d_ega_addr
notes: EGA pixel address/mask helper of 023A; dead

name: r3d_line_E
notes: EGA line (dispatch table E +6)

name: r3d_line_M
notes: mode M Bresenham line using y*320 table 85EC, colour 85D6.lo, no clipping

name: r3d_line_C
notes: CGA line; dead

name: r3d_line_T
notes: Tandy line; dead

name: r3d_edge_dda
notes: scan-converts edge into per-scanline min/max x tables L=DS:89AC+2y, R=DS:8D6E+2y; updates 9130 (min y)

name: r3d_wall_fill
notes: vertical wall: L=min(L,x), R=max(R,x) for rows ya..yb clamped to window

name: r3d_fill_E2
notes: EGA fill variant; dead

name: r3d_fill_E
notes: EGA fill; dead

name: r3d_fill_none
notes: fill type FB: clear tables only (no pixels)

name: r3d_fill_stipple
notes: fill type FC: 50% checker stipple of lo colour

name: r3d_fill_and
notes: fill type FE: AND colour onto backdrop pixels

name: r3d_fill_or
notes: fill type FD: OR colour onto backdrop pixels

name: r3d_fill_M
notes: mode M polygon fill from L/R tables starting at row 9130; FF solid, other hi = 2x2 dither lo/hi; resets tables (7FFF/8001)

name: r3d_fill_C
notes: CGA fill; dead

name: r3d_fill_T
notes: Tandy fill; dead

name: math_sin
notes: Q15 sine from quadrant table 14B2:0000 (2048 words); 65536=360deg

name: math_cos
notes: Q15 cosine = sin(a+4000h)

name: math_atan2
notes: angle 0..FFFF (4000h=90deg) from octant base DS:9178 +/- atan table 14B2:1000 (4096 words)

name: math_mul_sin
notes: (k*sin a)>>15

name: math_mul_cos
notes: (k*cos a)>>15

name: math_asin
notes: arcsin of Q15 x via table 14B2:3202 (1024 words), signed result

name: math_hypot2
notes: approx sqrt(a^2+b^2) = L + L*tab(S/L) with 256-entry table 14B2:3000

name: math_hypot3
notes: hypot2(hypot2(x,y),z); negative intermediate => h+|z|/2

name: mat_vec16
notes: in-place v=v*M>>15 (Q15 row vector times matrix)

name: mat_mul
notes: C=A*B 3x3 Q15 (row i of A times columns of B)

name: mat_row_mul
notes: helper of mat_mul: one output row

name: mat_transpose
notes: 3x3 transpose

name: mat_copy
notes: copies 9 words

name: vec_mat32
notes: out_k = sum v_j*M[3j+k] full 32-bit, unshifted

name: mat_from_euler
notes: rotation matrix from 3 angles (formulas in spec); callers DC64,DF08,E7AC,13E3,0FFB,31B

name: mat_to_euler
notes: inverse of 03A9: b=asin(m5), gimbal lock if |b|>3E80h

name: math_muldiv
notes: a*b/c with overflow-aware ordering

name: math_div32sat
notes: (hi:lo)/|d| with saturation 7FFF^sign

name: math_imul
notes: 32-bit product DX:AX

name: mat_from_euler_b
notes: alternative Euler order matrix; no callers
